layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, sinister, grim and evil, not cute. Their colours: ceremonial cloth of deep blood red and black, embroidered with tarnished gold occult sigils; dull brass; pale cream candle wax and parchment; bright red fresh blood on blades; and one small accent, a glowing spring green, only as candle flames and sparks.

layers.text: Subject: Initiate, a chunky shifty young man, a novice of an evil secret society and the smallest figure: a plain deep blood-red hooded robe with a black rope belt and a ragged pointed hem down to his black boots; the hood is up but his pale human face is clearly visible, with narrow suspicious eyes, a nasty smirk and dark stubble; one hand raises a curved sacrificial dagger whose steel blade is smeared with bright red blood, the other holds a short cream candle with a small green flame; simple shapes and very few details.
The figure is drawn large: about 44 pixels wide and 70 pixels tall. A human face with skin, eyes, nose and mouth shows under the hood.
